reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Verified: gossip path validates index < 128 via verify_data_column_sidecar (peerdas_helpers.nim:356), but sync path (request_manager.nim:190, validator_custody.nim:168) only calls verify_data_column_sidecar_inclusion_proof, which omits index validation. Sidecars from sync are stored via dataColumnQuarantine.put (request_manager.nim:437), triggering getIndex (blob_quarantine.nim:237) which performs unchecked indexMap[int(index)] access. indexMap is sized to NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS=128 (blob_quarantine.nim:830). Spec requirement from outputs/01e_PARTIAL_W2B3_1771748669.json line 209-211 states 'sidecar.index must be in range [0, NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS) to be accepted' with assertion 'forall sidecar: accepted(sidecar) => sidecar.index >= 0 && sidecar.index < NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS'. Code reading is factually correct, spec deviation is real (sync path accepts out-of-bounds indices). Single-client impact with potential for >5% network availability impact via targeted attack meets Medium threshold per BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json severity definitions.
